id: title:Gilbert09:add more support tools as self driving inbox sources

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion and signal emission support for three new external conversation sources: Vitally, Helpscout, and Decagon. This expands PostHog's ability to capture and display customer support or communication metadata from these specific vendors.
review.reason: The change adds three new signal input classes and their corresponding frontend API interfaces. P1.F8.H1 introduces the Vitally-specific configuration and field selection, while P1.F9.H1 and P1.F9.H2 extend the frontend API schema to recognize and display these new signal types.
